data.title: Abhisit urges probe into BMA project
data.description: Democrat leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has urged an investigation into the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration's cancellation of the Khu Bon retention pond project following land purchases by parties allegedly linked to City Hall.

data.title: Sri Lanka woos Thais ahead of 2027 expo
data.description: Sri Lanka is seeking Thai investment and business partnerships in sectors ranging from food and manufacturing to technology, tourism and healthcare as it prepares for Sri Lanka Expo 2027 in Colombo.

data.title: SYMPHONY elevates to the global stage, led by its Global Business Group
data.description: SYMPHONY COMMUNICATION PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED, or SYMPHONY, reinforces its strategic direction toward global expansion, led by its SYMPHONY Global Business Group (GBG) executive team, which plays a key role in driving international connectivity and elevating Thai enterprises to the global network.

data.title: MRTA opens properties to investment
data.description: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to develop nearly 70 sites to generate more revenue and make better use of its land, with the first major project planned for the Rama IX area.

data.title: Meetings prompt WFH order
data.description: The government has ordered Bangkok-based state agencies to work from home on three days next week to ease traffic during the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Group.

data.title: Dept revives coin tradition
data.description: The Treasury Department will launch a commemorative coin for the 2026 International Monetary Fund-World Bank Annual Meetings, reviving a tradition from the country's first hosting in 1991.

data.title: Anutin hit with no-confidence motion
data.description: Opposition parties have filed a no-confidence motion against Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and 17 ministers, citing alleged Senate election collusion, exam fraud and administrative failures.

data.title: Ex-prince Andrew raid warrants ruled 'unlawful' but UK police maintain probe
data.description: LONDON - Disgraced former prince Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor won a legal challenge over searches of his royal homes after police agreed the warrants they obtained were "unlawful", a High Court judge disclosed Thursday.

data.title: Prosecutors in Maradona death trial seek sentences up to 12 years
data.description: SAN ISIDRO (ARGENTINA) - Argentine prosecutors argued on Thursday that the "chaotic" medical team treating football legend Diego Maradona at the time of his death should receive prison sentences up to 12 years.

data.title: Protests, clashes as S. African anti-migrant tensions reignite
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - South African protesters clashed with foreign nationals on Thursday, police and an AFP reporter said, as tensions over migration were reignited by a court order that government must restart processing asylum applications.

data.title: US, Ukrainians, Europeans to discuss 'new ideas' to end war
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump's envoys will meet Ukrainian and European officials in Miami on Friday to discuss "new ideas" and seek a unified proposal to end the war with Russia, two US sources told AFP.

data.title: Madrid mourns evicted retiree, 'icon' of Spain housing protests
data.description: MADRID - Tens of thousands of mourners marched through Madrid on Thursday in tribute to a Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked national housing protests that culminated in the calling of early elections.

data.title: Trump gives 'national treasure' Musk top US medal after rift
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Donald Trump presented Elon Musk with the top US science medal on Thursday, as the rocket tycoon fully returned to the president's orbit after an explosive bust-up.

data.title: Argentina friendlies no fairy tale for African footballers
data.description: ABIDJAN - When Benin and Burkina Faso flew to Buenos Aires for friendlies against Argentina -- including superstar Lionel Messi's swansong-- it would have seemed like dreamland for players who rarely if ever rub shoulders with the aristocrats of the 'Beautiful Game'.

data.title: Russian data centre hit by drone in first for Ukraine war
data.description: MOSCOW - A drone attack caused a fire at a data centre belonging to Russian technology giant Yandex, the company told AFP Thursday, in the first strike of its kind on Russia.

data.title: Woman in botched US execution walking, mentally 'foggy'
data.description: WASHINGTON — The convicted US killer who survived a botched execution was walking around her hospital room though she was mentally "foggy," her lawyer said in an interview broadcast Thursday.

data.title: China announces candidate for WHO chief
data.description: BEIJING - China announced Thursday it had put forward a candidate to lead the World Health Organisation (WHO) -- a move that could signal intent to expand its influence at the WHO after the United States quit, even though questions persist about Beijing's transparency over the coronavirus disease 2019 (Covid-19) pandemic.

data.title: Rwanda to host F1 Grand Prix: sources close to both sides
data.description: KIGALI - Rwanda will host a Formula One (F1) Grand Prix, sources in the government and close to the sport's governing body told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) Thursday, marking the first race in decades on the African continent.

data.title: Britain's Burnham says open to Germany joining warplane project
data.description: BERLIN — British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Thursday that he was open to having Germany join a next-generation fighter jet project, after the collapse of a Franco-German warplane programme.

data.title: High school students turn out for new protests across France
data.description: PARIS — High school pupils across France launched a fresh day of protests on Thursday, despite government attempts to ease a crisis that has rocked the country for days.
